Subject: Witnessed deletion / legal cert for VPC tenant data (Acme Health)

Hi Jordan,

We need to coordinate a certified deletion for our tenant in your Private/VPC environment. Our legal and compliance teams require a signed attestation that particular data sets (PHI-backed test bucket + nightly snapshots) are fully deleted and irrecoverable, plus supporting artifacts suitable for audit.

Questions:
- Can Redwood provide a notarized or otherwise legally-signed affidavit/attestation for tenant wipe events?
- Do you support an independent third-party witness (e.g., an auditor) to observe the deletion and sign off? If so, what does scheduling look like and what evidence is produced?
- What are the exact artifacts we should expect (snapshot deletion logs, KMS key rotation events, manifest of deleted objects)?

We are targeting a compliance window the week of Nov 23; please let us know process and lead time.

Thanks,
Erin Mills
Compliance Manager
Acme Health
compliance@acmehealth.com

Subject: Re: Witnessed deletion / legal cert for VPC tenant data (Acme Health)

Thanks Erin — copying Operations and Product to scope this. Short answers up front, then next steps: we can provide an executed attestation from Redwood describing the deletion operations and attach machine-readable artifacts; we also offer an optional independent witness service (third party auditor) but that requires scheduling and a scope addendum.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa and Dev will draft the technical deletion plan and list of deliverables (manifests, logs, KMS events).
2) I will share a sample affidavit and the Redwood attestation template you can review for legal.
3) If you want a third-party witness, tell us whether a remote observation is acceptable or if you require on-site presence; we will provide an estimate and timeline.

Attaching our internal deletion checklist for visibility — it lists the operations we run for tenant teardown and the artifacts we capture. If you can confirm acceptance criteria (notarized signature vs digital signature, required fields in the manifest), we can lock in timelines.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

(attachment: redwood_deletion_checklist.pdf)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-03T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Witnessed deletion - technical plan draft

Jordan / Dev — draft plan below (technical notes). I will convert to a tidy deliverable for Acme once we align on the affidavit requirements.

Planned operations (order):
- Freeze writes on tenant (coord with Acme app owners).
- Snapshot and retention tombstone: mark all snapshots eligible and then issue deletion for snapshots (record snapshot IDs).
- Object store purge: multipart deletion for S3-like buckets; capture delete markers and final list.
- KV cache purge and persistent cache tombstones.
- KMS key rotation and destruction of tenant-specific CMK material (where supported); if customer provides BYOK, coordinate key handback/rotation.
- Metadata scrub from control plane (remove tenant references), followed by soft-delete tombstoning and final purge windows per agreed SLA.

Artifacts we can generate: deletion_manifest.csv (object paths + SHA256 + deletion timestamp + deleting-worker-id), deletion_audit_log.txt (service events + request IDs), kms_events.json (rotation / schedule events), snapshot_ids.txt.

Gaps/notes: for on-prem/private installs where storage is customer-controlled we provide attestation but cannot certify third-party access to customer network for physical witnessing without a scope addendum.

I'll attach the checklist and a sample manifest.

-Marissa
Director, Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

(attachment: internal_deletion_checklist_v2.pdf)

From: legal@acmehealth.com
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: pamela.ortiz@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-05T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Witnessed deletion / legal cert for VPC tenant data (Acme Health)

Jordan — thanks. A couple of clarifications from Legal:
1) For our auditors we will need either (A) a notarized affidavit signed by an authorized Redwood officer describing the deletion actions and evidence chain, or (B) a statement from Redwood plus an independent third-party witness report. A digital signature (DocuSign) is acceptable provided the document includes a signed chain-of-custody and an auditable signature verification log.
2) The deletion artifacts we require: deletion manifest, deletion audit log with request IDs, and KMS event IDs tied to the deleted tenant. We also need timestamps in UTC.
3) If you plan to rely on a third-party witness, that vendor must be an ISO27001 or SOC2-audited firm; please provide vendor credentials and contract terms.

Please also flag any evidence items that cannot be generated for our environment (Acme's VPC snapshot provider is customer-managed) — we need callouts in the attestation.

Regards,
Carmen Rios
Senior Counsel, Acme Health
legal@acmehealth.com

From: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
To: legal@acmehealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-07T10:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Witnessed deletion / legal cert for VPC tenant data (Acme Health)

Carmen — understood. Proposal from Redwood:

- Redwood can provide an executed affidavit (sample attached) signed by our Head of Security describing the deletion actions we executed, the artifacts produced, and the caveats for customer-managed storage components. The affidavit can be returned via DocuSign (we will include the signature verification log).

- For an independent witness: we partner with Aegis Audit (SOC2 + ISO27001). They can perform a remote witness and produce a signed report; on-site witnessing is possible with an engagement addendum (cost and schedule to be provided).

- Timeline: if Acme accepts the Redwood affidavit + DocuSign signature, we can complete procedural deletion and produce artifacts within 10 business days after scheduling the freeze window. If you require Aegis to witness, add 5–7 business days for scheduling and report generation.

Attaching a sample affidavit and the DocuSign link template. Please confirm whether DocuSign is acceptable or if you need a notarized wet signature; also confirm required manifest fields.

Thanks,
Jordan

(attachment: sample_affidavit.pdf)
(related link: https://www.docusign.com/step/abc123)

From: compliance@acmehealth.com
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@acmehealth.com, pamela.ortiz@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-09T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Witnessed deletion / legal cert for VPC tenant data (Acme Health)

Jordan — thank you. Acme will accept the Redwood-executed affidavit delivered via DocuSign, plus the machine-readable artifacts you described. We do not require an independent witness at this time. Requirements to confirm:
- Deletion manifest must include object path, SHA256, deletion timestamp in UTC, and request ID.
- Audit log must map request IDs to service events and worker IDs.
- KMS events must include event IDs and UTC timestamps (or a signed summary if raw key material was customer-owned and you cannot publish raw KMS artifacts).

Please proceed; once artifacts are ready please send to legal@acmehealth.com and upload the manifest to the secure S3 share we will provide. We expect delivery before Nov 30.

Jordan (for Redwood) — can you confirm expected delivery date so we can update our compliance calendar?

Erin Mills
Compliance Manager, Acme Health
